integrationChecks.scope: Existing arcade lobby is outside this game-owned candidate allowlist; verify after integration.

suite: Tide Feast independent offline interface audit
method: Production scripts evaluated unchanged in Node VM with event-capable DOM and finite-checking canvas mocks; actual UI handlers receive keyboard/pointer/storage/lifecycle events.
limitations: Offline DOM does not prove real-browser layout, accessibility tree, focus trapping, canvas raster quality or touch feel.
Responsive coverage combines actual renderer execution at target dimensions with static CSS inspection. No screenshot or browser interaction is claimed.
Native pointer capture, permission denial and storage events are simulated at the handler boundary.

responsiveAssessment.finding: 600px breakpoint reduces HUD/control dimensions; single-column guide, 2-column species grid; overlay padded 25px.
Max-1400 desktop rule and max-width container constrain canvas; 2-column guide and 3-column species grid.
Short-height media query sets 61px header, 302px stage and compact overlay; story hint/intro metadata hidden, with scrollable overlay safeguard.
